aboutSection.aboutData_myStartTextParagraph1: My journey in technology began early, during my childhood, exploring classic PCs from the 2000s. In my teenage years, this interest evolved into creating customized content using Photoshop, especially for the game The Sims. This experience awakened my creative side and, over time, allowed me to work as a graphic designer, even though I already held a degree in Nutrition.
aboutSection.aboutData_myStartTextParagraph2: In 2022, I had my first contact with web development, and that was when I realized technology could bring together creativity, logic, and professional purpose. I started by studying HTML and CSS and, from there, fully immersed myself in programming, learning independently through courses, training programs, and books. To strengthen my technical foundation, I enrolled in a Technology Degree in Web Development.
aboutSection.aboutData_myStartTextParagraph3: Throughout this period, I gained experience developing end-to-end web applications, using technologies such as JavaScript, TypeScript, .NET (C#), Node.js, React, and AWS. In my daily work, I apply best practices like Clean Code, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), SOLID, and DDD, while working with REST APIs, relational and non-relational databases, integrations, and scalable architectures, following agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban.
aboutSection.aboutData_myStartTextParagraph4: I am driven by continuous learning and the pursuit of efficient, well-structured digital solutions that create real impact. I enjoy understanding the problem before writing code and believe that well-applied technology should be clear, sustainable, escalable and centered on the user experience.
aboutSection.aboutData_currentObjectiveText: I seek to apply my knowledge in a dynamic professional environment. I'm excited about contributing to collaborative teams, sharing skills, adding value and learning from experienced colleagues. I highly value continuous learning and am ready to absorb new knowledge and put it into practice. My commitment to personal and professional growth is solid, and I value discipline and consistency.
aboutSection.aboutData_curiosityText: Joining my interest in graphic design, I created the [DressCode Company](https://reserva.ink/dresscodecompany), a clothing brand focused on the dev community. When I was looking for programming-themed t-shirts and couldn't find any that suited me, I decided to create my own prints and share them with the community.

educationSection.educationData_aboutWebDev: In the course I learn about computer logic, modeling, programming and database development, object-oriented language, interface and usability, responsive development and other subjects that involve web programming.
educationSection.educationData_levelExplorer: Training course to enter the programming market
educationSection.educationData_aboutExplorer: In the course I learn about the most widely used technologies and techniques today and put them into practice in many projects, using the concept of mobile first, DOM manipulation, Clean Code principles, ES6 Modules and others.

projectsSection.projectsData_descriptionConvite15Anos: Interactive 15th birthday invitation developed as a SPA, allowing guests to navigate through different sections of the invitation. The application features an introductory welcome page, a main page with event details (date, time, location, and dress code), as well as integrated actions such as Google Maps access and RSVP confirmation. It also includes a dedicated page for sending gifts via Pix, with a QR code and Pix key.
projectsSection.projectsData_descriptionFoodExplorer: Application that simulates a restaurant menu, two personas can access it: an admin and a customer. The customer can view the menu, search for dishes, and see details of specific dishes. The admin, in addition to the same functions as the customer, can also manage it by adding new dishes and editing or deleting existing ones.
projectsSection.projectsData_descriptionRocketNotes: Application for the user to create notes and save them to their account, allowing searches by title or tags using the interactive menu. Additionally, they can also configure their profile by adding a custom user image. I worked with CRUD, authentication tokens, and password encryption.
projectsSection.projectsData_descriptionSPLabs: Landing page created for a technical challenge. On it I had to develop a dynamic chat window connected to the API provided by the company, which simulates a virtual assistant and answers messages covering a group of commands, such as 'piada', 'comandos', 'teste', etc. Support for Portuguese only.
projectsSection.projectsData_descriptionPokemonGallery: A website that brings together 200 species of pokemon, 10 per page. I've also created a search box by name. Each card has the name of the pokemon and its type.
projectsSection.projectsData_descriptionGitFav: In this project the user can create a private list with favorite Github users, which will list the number of public repositories and their repositories and their followers, as well as their name and github id.
projectsSection.projectsData_descriptionFocusTimer2.1: Timer based on the pomodoro focus method. It starts with 25 minutes (by default). But the user can manipulate the time with the add and subtract buttons. There is also a dark mode button and four buttons with background sounds, simulating different environments, like rainy and a coffee shope.
projectsSection.projectsData_descriptionSPAUniverse: SPA (Single-Page Application) page developed using only JS, HTML and CSS. It contains basic information and trivia about the universe.
